# Digi_TransX
> Honest pre-launch product overview under D-HAG (https://digi-transx.d-hag.com/)

## What Digi_TransX Covers
Digi_TransX is a digital transport marketplace under D-HAG built from family transport-operations experience. This public site explains the live one-time shipment workflow conceptually without exposing private pricing percentages, penalty rules, internal reserve minimums, or unlaunched modules.

## One-Time Shipment Workflow
1. Everyday and business seekers post structured shipment requirements.
2. Rule-based truck compatibility filtering surfaces open loads only to eligible fleets in service range without automatic dispatch overrides.
3. Fleet transporters submit open vehicle-backed bids so seekers compare trucks, history, and rates transparently.
4. Accepted offers move into a test escrow checkout hold concept.
5. Transporters dispatch contracted drivers (per-trip or permanent hire) or enable verified Owner-Operator self-drive mode ("Drive Myself"). Drivers execute one active accepted trip at a time and may never post marketplace orders or bid independently.
6. Cargo delivery uses physical inspection first followed by a one-time completion OTP to unlock staged internal settlement, or opens a frozen dispute under contextual chat and admin arbitration.

## Honest Pre-Launch Status
- Stage: Private internal testing; not publicly launched.
- Checkout: Uses dummy test-card flows only (no live payment gateway or bank payouts yet).
- Tracking: External vehicle GPS tracker hardware integration remains offline/planned; internal builds use trip-scoped smartphone check-ins only during accepted active driver runs.
- Security & Polish: Auth, session/device controls, secondary PIN hardening, and frontend-backend alignment remain under active refinement.
